requirements.requirement: A caller can inspect the frozen policies and artifact schemas before evaluating a transition.

requirements.requirement: A malformed subject artifact is denied with each violated structural rule named.
requirements.proof: schema::tests::instance_collects_object_rules_and_nested_properties returns all simultaneous required, additionalProperties, and nested minLength violations; evaluate.rs::schema_deny_reports_every_simultaneous_structural_violation proves checker-to-denial projection preserves every exact path/rule pair in deterministic order; existing evaluate.rs structural-denial tests cover absent, unparseable, revision-link, and context-independent cases.

requirements.requirement: A checked transition refuses stale, self-authored, duplicate-author, or configured-obligation-incomplete evidence.
The reference workflow reaches its terminal state only after its configured validation obligations are satisfied.
